title: Transforming Delete, Retrieve, Generate Approach for Controlled Text Style Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to perform text style transfer between male and female stylistic markers using the GENDER dataset (Yelp reviews), measured via human evaluations and automatic metrics (target style classification accuracy, BLEU, and GLEU).

Evaluating the model's ability to transfer text between Democrat and Republican political slants using the POLITICAL dataset (Facebook comments), measured via human evaluations and automatic metrics (target style classification accuracy, BLEU, and GLEU).
